Original resource extent: 1 manuscript map ; ink drawing ; 56 x 67 centimeters.
Publication statement: [place of publication not identified] : [publisher not identified], [1700 to 1799]

This manuscript map shows the Atlantic coast of southern Brazil from Ilhéus to the Prata River, and the interior with the tributaries of the Paraná, Paraguai, and Uruguay rivers. Also shown are the main churches and chapels in the provinces.
Title devised, in English, by Library staff.
